test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : IPJ :: NUO : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : IPJ :: NUO : %

**Option 1) # = KRL, % = LSM**

**For # (KRL) to IPJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce7326557d99f86ff75b771867b8893c857dd0fb23657b24971af61cb13da183.png] 

 

**For NUO to % (LSM)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdd62ab5bc14591a3a4f849445164d7c66ebda3cc30fdf0fbebad51271d50113.png] 

 

Since the pattern for KRL to IPJ (-2, -2, -2) is the same as the pattern for NUO to LSM (-2, -2, -2), **Option 1 is correct.**

 

**Option 2) # = KRL, % = NSL**

**For # (KRL) to IPJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/769573addf311c5f9ab19152bc8630a5e6f91039d6e179fd76e112bfd73b72dd.png] 

The pattern derived from KRL to IPJ is: (-2, -9, -2).

**For NUO to % (NSL)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f4436b10a7818b97dde630c052067fc97e1ee70216e155cef329c9250413d40.png] 

 

Since the pattern for KRL to IPJ (-2, -9, -2) is not the same as the pattern for NUO to NSL (0, -2, -3), Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = KRJ, % = NSM**

**For # (KRJ) to IPJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18862136dfa046bec83b6227a2e7f8551bb8a3e9e56e33a70a7cfbe38c0feeeb.png] 

The pattern derived from KRJ to IPJ is: (-2, -2, 0).

**For NUO to % (NSM)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f4436b10a7818b97dde630c052067fc97e1ee70216e155cef329c9250413d40.png] 

 

Since the pattern for KRJ to IPJ (-2, -2, 0) is not the same as the pattern for NUO to NSM (0, -2, -2), Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = KRL, % = NRM**

**For # (KRL) to IPJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc44f0985fd4cde31bce63eaf263ab6f1e2576b5c477d20ccbc66c4f9bf4adf6.png] 

 

**For NUO to % (NRM)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9b41d4cac0942a95626f16efb468f118f3d5ff848202352d4824e663c04445.png] 

 

Since the pattern for KRL to IPJ (-2, -2, -2) is not the same as the pattern for NUO to NRM (0, -3, -2), Option 4 is incorrect.

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 1.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
